prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look. Interior room seen from above, cut-away walls on the top edge only, floor fills most of the image: "Gerichtssaal", a small, slightly shabby courtroom for petty cases in a cyberpunk justice building - polished dark wooden parquet floor as the large walkable area, a long red runner carpet down the central aisle. Keep all important objects inside the central area; the outer strips at the far left and right edges are plain wall or floor.
TOP WALL: dark wood panelling with steel ribs, a big round window with a pale-blue balance scales symbol (no letters), two old flags as plain coloured cloth, a flickering wall screen (picture only).
TOP CENTER: the raised judge's bench - the most eye-catching spot: a massive elevated wooden desk with a gavel, a stack of files, a green banker's lamp, a tiny potted cucumber plant and a tall leather chair behind it.
LEFT of the judge's bench: a small wooden witness stand box with a microphone on a gooseneck. RIGHT of the judge's bench: a clerk's counter with a hatch, a stamp rack, a bounty terminal glowing cyan and a little brass bell.
LOWER HALF: two blocks of old wooden spectator benches in three rows each, left and right of the central aisle, worn and scratched.
BOTTOM CENTER: the double door out to the courtyard, one wing open, cold night light coming in. A coat stand and a bench for the guard next to the door.
Small stuff at the edges: a water dispenser, a potted plant, cables drawn thin, a mop bucket.
EXITS clearly readable: BOTTOM edge center - the double door out to the courtyard.
Time: daytime, warm yellow lamp light mixed with cool grey daylight from high windows.
